Test a DBA combination to see if iterative refinement improves over trimmed mean in this unstable ranking scenario.
try a different weighting scheme (softmax_neg_error) to see if a more aggressive weight distribution improves over inverse_error, given unstable ranking.
use inverse error on the top-7 models to leverage their strengths while reducing influence of weaker ones
The series has unstable ranking and strong seasonality; a median over the full pool may provide robustness to outliers and ranking volatility.
try a per‑horizon top‑k mean on the full pool to capture horizon‑specific strengths (high seasonality, unstable ranking).
The series shows strong seasonality and an unstable ranking, so a robust median over a small, diverse pool may outperform weighted approaches.
softmax on the top‑7 stable models
test a simple mean on the full pool to see if a non‑robust average can beat the robust median; this is a different combination type.
per‑horizon best‑per‑horizon weighting on the top‑7 stable models
The ranking is unstable and many models cluster; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting on the full pool could capture horizon‑specific strengths.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9562. Series context: trend strength 0.9973 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.057); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.566.
